answer: Require every new identity to collect five independent vouches from established peers, each voucher locking 200 POA for 60 days and capped at three vouches per epoch, plus a 500 POA bond. A second fake cannot reuse the same vouches, so an attacker must recruit a fresh set and the cost of buying trust rises with every identity. Like a jetty that only holds when each piling is sound, verifiers audit randomly for 12 epochs, and proven links slash 50% of voucher stakes and the full bond, while honest identities are released after 30 days into a karst landscape where lotus-like copies stand out.
